purpose: Playable-area geometry for the user-selected region: Israel proper, the Golan Heights, and the West Bank; Gaza, surrounding countries, and Mediterranean/Red Sea waters are excluded. This is a gameplay selection, not a sovereignty or legal-border claim.
geometrySemantics: One Feature with dissolved MultiPolygon geometry. All selected source polygons were unioned to remove administrative seams and overlaps. The inverse mask is the world rectangle [-180,-85,180,85] minus this same dissolved geometry.

sources.sourceDescription: OpenStreetMap, Wambacher; boundaryYearRepresented 2017; boundaryID ISR-ADM0-37499698; sourceDataUpdateDate 2023-01-19; buildDate 2023-12-12. Includes Golan Heights and East Jerusalem, as verified by point tests.

Raster2polygon from Sentinel-2 10m Land Cover, Image Year 2021; water removed; dissolved and ADM0 overlaps erased; processed by IMB. boundaryID PSE-ADM0-62339095; sourceDataUpdateDate 2023-01-19; buildDate 2023-12-12.

selection.ISR: Retained original Polygon, all rings, without added border lines.

PSE.rule: Select whole components with minimum longitude >34.8°. The components are geographically disconnected; this rule does not draw or cut a boundary.

processing: Fetched original unsimplified GeoJSON from the publisher-pinned Git LFS objects.
Selected complete source polygon components; no boundaries were hand-drawn, buffered, or generalized.
Removed third coordinate dimensions if any, rounded to seven decimal degrees (approximately centimetre scale), closed rings, and normalized RFC 7946 ring orientation.
Retained source interior holes, including inland water holes.
Dissolved the complete selected source polygons with polygon-clipping 0.15.7 (MIT); precomputed the inverse world mask. The library is only used at build time and adds no runtime dependency.
attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0) and geoBoundaries; PSE component CC BY 4.0. Retain these source-specific licenses when redistributing this collection.
limitations: Source boundaries represent different years and are not survey-grade. Small overlaps or gaps can exist at the source seam between components.
OSM-derived ISR coastline is substantially more detailed than Natural Earth 1:10m and follows real coast geometry; shoreline changes after 2017 may differ.
The region excludes Gaza and does not expand into any surrounding country or later military-controlled area.

Source inland-water holes remain excluded. The dissolved main polygon has 52 holes; most are small water features or narrow source-seam differences, so membership is geometric rather than a guarantee for every shoreline point.
derivedArtifactLicense: ODbL-1.0; retain attribution to the CC-BY-4.0 PSE input. Upstream sources retain their respective licenses.

currentPoiValidation.recommendation: Exclude current offshore coordinates from eligible rounds; do not enlarge the land mask to accommodate the records. Re-review authoritative entrance coordinates if these places are wanted later.
